result:
The notes app is in `notes/` (`index.html`, `style.css`, `app.js`). Open `notes/index.html` in a browser to use it. I only syntax-checked `app.js` with `node --check`. I haven't run it in a browser, so none of it has been tried out yet.

- **Notes:** each note has a title, a body and comma-separated tags, and you can pin notes to the top. They autosave to the browser's `localStorage` (Ctrl/⌘ S saves immediately), and edits made in another tab show up in the open one.
- **Finding things:** the search box matches title, body and tags, and every word you type has to match. Tags show in the sidebar and filter the list when clicked. The sidebar also has All, Pinned and Trash views with counts.
- **Trash:** Delete moves a note to Trash. From there you can restore it, delete it forever (with a confirmation), or empty the trash. Notes in Trash are purged automatically after 30 days.
- **Markdown preview:** the Preview toggle renders headings, bold, italic, strikethrough, inline and fenced code, lists, quotes, links and task lists. You can tick task checkboxes in the preview and the change is written back to the note.
- **Backup:** Export downloads all notes as JSON. Import merges a JSON file back in, keeping the newer copy when the same note exists in both. Each note can also be downloaded as a `.md` file.
- **Layout and shortcuts:** the layout adapts to phone widths and follows your light or dark system theme. Shortcuts are Alt N (new note), Ctrl/⌘ K (search), Alt P (preview) and Esc to clear the search box.

- **Not included:** sync, folders, images, rich-text editing and a manual theme toggle. Data lives only in this browser's `localStorage`, so clearing site data deletes your notes. Use Export regularly as a backup.
- **If saving fails:** if the browser's storage fills up, the status line shows a warning telling you to export.
